name: tallyvane-storybook
description: Showcase for Tier 0+ reusable components. Imports frontend-shared today; will also read stories from frontend-web/src and frontend-admin/src once those layers have Tier 3+ components of their own. See docs/frontend/02-component-testing-architecture.md for why this is its own package rather than living inside frontend-shared.

scripts.test:a11y: pnpm run build-storybook && playwright test --project=desktop a11y.spec.ts
scripts.test:contrast: pnpm run build-storybook && playwright test --project=desktop contrast-wcag.spec.ts contrast-apca.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual: pnpm run build-storybook && playwright test --project=desktop --project=tablet --project=mobile visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm run build-storybook && playwright test visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
